query: What anchor selection criteria and linking strategy (concurrent vs separate calibration) will ensure valid cross‑site score alignment?

response.query: What anchor selection criteria and linking strategy (concurrent vs separate calibration) will ensure valid cross‑site score alignment?
response.answer: For valid cross-site score alignment, use common anchor items and apply separate calibration for more precise adjustments. Concurrent calibration may lead to less accurate alignment.

At any time, it has a list of tables it knows about - these are displayed in the Control Window which is the first thing you see when you start up the program. When you select a table in the list by clicking on it, you can see general information about it in the control window, and you can also open more specialised view windows which allow you to inspect it in more detail or edit it. - Add Corner Plot Table option to DataLink Window Action selector. - Opening Sky Plot Window when a MOC table is selected now automatically plots it like a MOC. - Fix time format reselection in Time plot window when changing tables. - Fix regression bug since v4.10 that caused broken COUNT column in Import as Table result from Histogram Plot. - New toolbar toggle button Replot on Data Change in plot windows to control whether global variable and subset/column changes instantly affect plots.
